name: Silent hand-drawn explainer told in a typed caption strip (12 fps, no audio)

source.location: external: user reference folder (resolve with --root or MOTION_REFERENCE_ROOTS); never copied into the repository
source.creator: unknown

rights.attribution: Unknown creator; supplied by the user as a private study reference.

brand_assets.description: Product name in the title and end card
Third-party protocol names in boxes and clouds, and a website address

rights.notes: Rights unverified. Brand explainer; reuse the caption-as-voice structure and notebook staging only, with original drawings and copy.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, session A) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (64 frames) and motion sheet (4 windows at 10 fps) in place of a transitions sheet (none was made: the detector found 0 boundaries), one full-resolution frame at 7.6 s and a strip 42.5-44.0 s at 12 fps; confirmed with ffprobe that the file has a video stream only, so there is no listen sheet. Caption pace measured by counting word blobs in the caption band at the source 12 fps (prompts/state/reference-parallel/batch-2/measure_caption_pace.py, calibrated on the 7.6 s frame: 19 of 19 words); counts only, no text kept.
analysis.coverage: Full 58 s; every caption cue and every redraw located by the caption measurement.

concept.observed: A software tool explains in the first person what it sees when a user connects a crypto wallet: positions as boxes, a health gauge watched overnight while the price falls, an automatic repay at a trigger, a smaller loan in the morning, other jobs (moving a loan, a recipe of steps, a stop on a chart, a practice mode), the many protocols it knows, what it can and cannot do (you hold the key), and its sign-off.
concept.interpreted: A trust-building explainer: the tool's point of view, modest and calm, drawn like a notebook.

communication_style.observed: Pencil-and-marker drawings on grey paper with handwritten labels and blue hand annotations; the whole script is a typed caption on a taped paper strip; no sound.

palette.observed: Light grey paper, graphite lines, one blue for annotations and highlights, a yellow highlighter loop, red for the danger threshold; a dark bar under the caption strip.

typography.observed: A handwritten-style font for labels and the caption; a handwritten title with a blue underline.

composition.observed: Drawing in the upper 80% of the frame; the caption strip of paper taped over a dark bottom bar (about y 590-690 of 720), centred text, 1-3 lines.

motion.observed: Drawings appear element by element at 12 fps (stepped motion); a price line draws down; a gauge level falls and recovers; a small figure hops between protocol clouds leaving a dotted trail (42.6-44.0 s); a hand loop and a blue note mark one position (7.0-7.7 s); moon and sun icons mark night and morning.

transitions.observed: The detector found no boundaries because both sides of every change are pale paper. Strips show hard cuts to an empty page followed by a redraw (7.95 to 8.05 s, 45.95 to 46.05 s). Each of the 10 caption cues starts on the redraw frame at a whole second (3.0, 8.0, 14.0, 20.0, 27.0, 32.0, 41.0, 46.0, 52.0 s).
transitions.interpreted: One page, wiped and redrawn: the notebook metaphor; the caption and the page change together.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Scenes of 4-9 s, one per caption cue.

sound_design.observed: No audio track: the container holds one H.264 video stream and nothing else (ffprobe).
sound_design.interpreted: A silent film by design; nothing to measure.

narration.observed: None: no audio. The monologue is carried by the caption. Measured on the caption band: 10 cues, 192 words in 57.9 s (199 words a minute on screen); each cue types in at 6.3-8.3 words/s (median 7.8) and then holds complete for 1.4-4.9 s (median 3.5 s); 8-32 words per cue (median 17.5).
narration.interpreted: Reading replaces listening: the type-on is about twice speaking speed, and the hold gives reading time, so a viewer reads at their own pace.

captions.observed: Lower-third paper strip, centred, 1-3 lines, typed word by word with no highlight; a new cue replaces the old one on a redraw at a whole second; each cue stays 2.9-8.9 s from first word to clear. The caption is the only voice of the film.

motifs.observed: Notebook paper, tape and hand annotation; night and day icons; a thermometer-style gauge.

scenes.observed: Handwritten title with an underline; the caption introduces the film.
A wallet address branches into three position boxes; a loop marks one.
One position: numbers and a health gauge.
Night: the price line falls and the gauge drops toward the red line.
A trigger and a step list: repay part of the loan in one transaction.
Morning: a smaller loan and a check mark.
Other jobs: moving a loan, a recipe of steps, a stop on a chart, practice mode.
Protocol names as clouds; a small figure hops between them.
You hold the key; the tool holds a pencil; what it cannot do.
Sign-off over the night scene with the gauge.

moments.observed: A 26-word caption types in over 3.2 s while the step list draws above it, then holds 3.75 s.
moments.interpreted: Text pace and drawing pace are locked: the drawing finishes while the reader catches up.

moments.observed: A yellow hand loop circles one position box and a blue handwritten note appears under it.

difficult: Hand-drawn stepped drawing at 12 fps: a native approximation (stroke draws on twos) loses the pencil texture
uncertainties: Line boil was not confirmed: the 12 fps strip at 42.5-44.0 s shows the moving figure and the caption, but outline jitter is not visible at strip size
Word counts come from ink blobs; a hyphenated or very short word next to punctuation may be merged (calibration frame: exact)

sampling.cut_refinement: every frame inside the coarse step
